notes: §1985:VI.6.15.3 SR3: "A format 1 GO TO statement, without procedure-name-1, can only appear in a single statement paragraph." PlacementRules.BareGoToAlone (selected by SequenceRuleOf for a target-less GO TO, asked only where Constructs.BareGotoRemoved2002 admits the statement, i.e. at 85) refuses with COBOL6818 a bare GO TO nested in IF, sharing its sentence (DISPLAY "X" GO TO; GO TO DISPLAY "X"), or one of 2 sentences in its paragraph (before or after another sentence, or two bare GO TOs), and accepts the paragraph whose only statement it is: probes P1. GO TO. altered by ALTER ... TO PROCEED TO and P3. GO TO. on the paragraph-name line ran to the altered targets. Edition arm: at --std 2002 and 2023 VersionConformancePass.VisitGoToStatement refuses the bare GO TO with COBOL0811 (deleted by ISO 2002). Witness: a bare GO TO as a second sentence, refused COBOL6818.
